prose.against: The case against rests mostly on growth: growth scores only 31 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: the recent price trend, who owns the company, price behaviour.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 9 points in favour and 4 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 67 of 100. The side that carries most weight is cash flow and the balance sheet.
